title.zh: 活跃通勤（代步车定义）条例 2026
title.en: Active Mobility (Definition of Mobility Vehicle) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Active Mobility (Definition of Mobility Vehicle) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 27 February 2026.

2. For the purposes of paragraph (c) of the definition of “mobility vehicle” in section 2(1) of the Act, a non‑motorised wheelchair that —
(a)is designed to carry an individual who is unable to walk or has difficulty in walking; and
(b)is propelled by a motorised attachment that —
(i)does not form part of the wheelchair;
(ii)has one or more wheels; and
(iii)is steered by handlebars,
is a mobility vehicle.
